name: Exchange rate
basis: Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago mid-rate (held near 6.78 for several years)

name: Employment on-cost
basis: Salary plus allowances, pension, NIS and benefits

name: Productive hours per person
basis: Working year less leave and training

name: Loaded hourly rate L1 Chief Executive
basis: TTD 120,000 per month x 12 x on-cost / hours / FX
source: Assumption scaled from Paylab T&T bands

name: Loaded hourly rate L2 Vice President
basis: TTD 80,000 per month
source: Assumption scaled from Paylab T&T bands

name: Loaded hourly rate L3 Manager
basis: TTD 45,000 per month
source: Assumption scaled from Paylab T&T bands

name: Loaded hourly rate L4 Lead / Superintendent
basis: TTD 32,000 per month
source: Assumption scaled from Paylab T&T bands

name: Loaded hourly rate L5 Senior Professional / Supervisor
basis: TTD 24,000 per month
source: Paylab: petroleum engineer TTD 8.8k-21.1k per month (top decile above 21k)

name: Loaded hourly rate L6 Professional / Specialist
basis: TTD 16,000 per month
source: Paylab petroleum engineer band midpoint; ERI EHS engineer TTD 64 per hour base

name: Loaded hourly rate L7 Technician / Administrative
basis: TTD 9,000 per month
source: Paylab T&T maintenance and technician bands

name: Inspection contractor technician (NDT)
basis: Day rate including margin, equipment and certification

name: Crude oil price
basis: ICE Brent mid-November 2026 (about USD 95; ACE crude priced at Brent parity for the demo)

name: Gas price to the Gas Buyer
basis: Public Trinidad gas price to light industrial customers used as a proxy

name: Offshore helicopter (AW139 class)
basis: Charter USD 5.5k-7.5k per hour; operating cost about USD 7.3k per hour at 200 h per year

name: Helicopter round trip Point Lisas area to Gulf of Paria platform
basis: Short over-water sector both ways plus taxi

name: Helicopter passenger seats
basis: AW139 offshore configuration 2 + 12

name: Fast crew / supply boat
basis: SEACOR Marine fast support vessel average day rate Q3 2025 (USD 14k)

name: Platform supply vessel
basis: SEACOR average USD 19.5k (Q3 2025); Tidewater USD 23.2k (Q2 2025)

name: Average benefit of an implemented C1 change
basis: Minor improvements: efficiency, reliability, small savings

name: Average benefit of an implemented C2 change
basis: Configuration, limits, procedures and roles: uptime, cost or risk reduction

name: Average benefit of an implemented C3 change
basis: Major changes: debottlenecks, new tie-ins, major hazard risk reduction

name: Unplanned shutdown after a loss of containment
basis: Typical repair and restart for a production vessel or line

name: Added chance of failure for an overdue SCE inspection
basis: Chance that undetected degradation causes a loss of containment while overdue

name: Chance of failure after an on-time inspection
basis: Residual chance after inspection and repair
